evidence.quote: [Types of interface endpoint services for Neptune Analytics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune-analytics/latest/userguide/gettingStarted-connecting-private-link-types.md)

name: AWS PrivateLink
summary: Neptune Analytics supports two services via interface VPC endpoints on AWS PrivateLink: neptune-graph for accessing Neptune Analytics control plane API operations like CreateGraph, DeleteGraph etc. and neptune-graph-data for accessing Neptune Analytics data plane API operations like GetQuery, ListQueries, ExecuteQuery etc.
